name: Tonak
instructions: 1. Pressure cook the soaked chickpeas until soft and set aside.
2. In a pan, dry roast grated coconut, red chillies, coriander seeds, cumin, peppercorns, cloves, and cinnamon until golden brown.
3. Grind the roasted mixture with a small piece of tamarind and water into a smooth, thick paste.
4. Heat coconut oil in a pot and sauté the chopped onions and green chilies until translucent.
5. Add the ground masala paste to the pot and sauté for a few minutes.
6. Mix in the boiled chickpeas along with some of the cooking water to reach the desired consistency.
7. Add salt and simmer for 10-15 minutes until the flavors meld together.
8. Serve hot with Goan pav or rice.
description: Tonak is a quintessential Goan GSB (Gaud Saraswat Brahmin) curry. It is a staple dish often prepared during festivals, weddings, and special occasions, showcasing the Goan mastery of balancing roasted spices with fresh coconut.
